name: Pump Hand
blurb: You kept the water moving. Strong back, good hands, few words.

name: Clinic Aide
blurb: You stitched cuts and sat with the dying. Calm under pressure.

name: Door Watch
blurb: You stood guard at a door nobody had knocked on in ninety years. Until now.

name: Archive Clerk
blurb: You copied old records by lamplight. You know how to talk to people, and to machines.
